claims.text: Netflix: 301.6 million paid memberships at the end of 2024 (Q4 2024 shareholder letter, 21 Jan 2025)
Open Connect is Netflix's own CDN; its Open Connect Appliances are given free of charge to qualifying ISPs and placed inside their networks (and at IXPs)
OCAs are filled proactively during a nightly off-peak fill window, with content chosen by predicted popularity for that region
Per-title encode optimization (Dec 2015): each title gets its own bitrate-resolution ladder based on its complexity
Streams are segmented into chunks of a few seconds; the client's adaptive-bitrate logic picks a bitrate per chunk from measured throughput and buffer
Netflix's control plane (sign-in, browsing, recommendations, playback authorisation and steering to OCAs) runs on AWS; the video bytes come from OCAs
